quotes.text: 7th. The Plates or Records of Zeniff, containing the records of his people from the time they left the land of Zarahemla, were commenced by Zeniff, who was probably the brother of Amaleki, (Omni 15 ; Mos. vi. 1,) and were handed down till they came into the possession of king Limhi, from whom they were transferred to king Mosiah, when the subjects of those two kings became united as one people.…

After their settlement here, part of the family being righteous, and part wicked xtnd rebellious, they had considerable difficulty and strife, until at length the Lamanites, the wicked portion of the family, were smitten with a skin of blackness and became an idle and filthy people.

"The Gentiles would not endure sound doctrine, but heaped to
themselves teachers.
